title: Effects of maternal and post-weaning microbe-derived antioxidants on sow performance, redox status, fecal microorganisms, and growth performance, inflammatory responses and intestinal microbiota of weaned piglets
abstract_conclusion: Maternal MA supplementation during late gestation and lactation increased litter size at weaning, which may be associated with improved milk quality and redox status. Furthermore, maternal MA supplementation may enhance growth performance of post-weaning piglets, potentially linking to improvements in immunological parameters and gut microbiome.
